[SWS_DM_01062] Transmission of all PDIDs on the periodic connection
⌈
If the PDID transmission is triggered for a requested transmission rate, the DM shall
transmit all PDIDs on the periodic transmission on the periodic connection starting with
the first PDID in the list of scheduled PDIDs.
⌋
